OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            ('+' followed by 8 to 15 digits); on create a national number is assumed to be '+61'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - displayName
            - initials
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'

## Summary

I implemented the `customerCode` assignment on `POST /api/owners` following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**What the code does:** on owner creation, `customerCode` is set to `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` where `LAST3` is the upper-cased first three letters of `lastName` and `NNNN` is a zero-padded 4-digit global sequence equal to `(current owner count) + 1` — computed *before* this owner is saved, so two owners created in sequence get consecutive numbers (e.g. `SMI-0007` then `JON-0008`).

**Changes:**
1. **`Owner.java`** — added a `customerCode` field (`@Column(name = "customer_code")`) with getter/setter.
2. **`AssignCustomerCode.java`** (new function class) — reads the built `@Val Owner`, computes the code from `lastName` + `ownerRepository.findAll().size() + 1`, and mutates the owner in place.
3. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted an `assignCode` step between `build` and `save`, under the same `transaction` governance.
4. **`openapi.yml`** — added `customerCode` as a read-only property on the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and it appears in `GET /api/owners/{id}` responses (MapStruct maps it by name automatically).
5. **Schema SQL** (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres) — added the `customer_code` column; fixed hsqldb's positional seed inserts in `data.sql` to include the new column.

The endpoint keeps the DTO-at-the-edges shape: the assignment operates on the entity mid-pipeline, and the value flows out through the existing `RespondWithOwnerCreated` responder and the GET path via the mapper.
